entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A mountainous location in New Argive on Dominaria holding a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Koilos lies.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane connected to Koilos by the planar portal.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Ancient empire whose remnants lie in the caves of Koilos.

entities.name: Untouchables
entities.description: Sick people who inhabited the Caves of the Damned, ill from powerstone exposure.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Ushered the last Thran survivors into the portal; later came through to invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Found the caves with Mishra and Tocasia, called his half of the powerstone the Mightstone, and later defeated Gix.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother; found the caves, later returned with Ashnod and went into Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Member of the expedition that found the caves.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Accompanied Mishra to Koilos and through the portal.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian who used Koilos as his base, manipulating both sides of the Brothers' War; defeated by Urza.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Machine-worshipping monks sent dreams by Gix who reactivate the portal.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian sleeper agent who betrayed Phyrexia, allied with Urza and sacrificed herself against Gix.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A young man resembling Mishra who traveled with Xantcha and sacrificed himself against Gix.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Sought Koilos for information on the Golgothian Sylex and was buried by Rona.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: Led the second Phyrexian invasion from Koilos with Sheoldred and buried Karn.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Co-leader of the second invasion staged in the caves.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who found and freed Karn.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship that sealed the portal after Yawgmoth came through.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's half of the large powerstone found in the Hall of Tagsin.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's half of the large powerstone.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War between Urza and Mishra in which Koilos plays a part.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Koilos's portal was an important launch site.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: The beautiful capital of the Thran Empire, mostly ruins by the Brothers' War.

events.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed builds a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.
events.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia .

events.summary: At the end of the Thran Civil War Yawgmoth ushers the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia.
events.quote: Yawgmoth ushered the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia .

events.summary: Urza, Tocasia and Mishra find the caves and a large powerstone; they claim halves, accidentally open the portal, and flee su-chi attackers.
events.quote: However, they unwittingly opened the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia and were attacked by su-chi

events.summary: Mishra returns with Ashnod, reactivates the portal, steps into Phyrexia and brings back three dragon engines but is discovered by Gix.
events.quote: Mishra charmed three dragon engines and brought them back to Dominaria

events.summary: Gix guides the Brotherhood of Gix across the desert to reactivate the portal, steps through and gives them his name.
events.quote: twelve of them arrived at the caves and reactivated the portal.

events.summary: Gix uses Koilos as his base for the rest of the war, manipulating both sides.
events.quote: Gix kept using Koilos as his base of operations for the remainder of the war

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe visit Koilos; Xantcha reads Thran glyphs and learns the Thran and Phyrexians share origins.
events.quote: She realized the Thran and the Phyrexians had common origins, and that Gix had been one of them.

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves so Urza can defeat Gix in the Sacrifice at Koilos.
events.quote: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrificed themselves so that Urza could defeat Gix.

events.summary: After the Thaw, Yawgmoth comes through the portal to invade Dominaria, but the Weatherlight seals it again.
events.quote: Yawgmoth came through to invade Dominaria , but the Weatherlight sealed it again.

events.summary: Karn seeks Koilos for information about the Golgothian Sylex and finds a clay tablet referring to it.
events.quote: found a clay tablet referring to the Sylex.

events.summary: Rona and Sheoldred stage the second invasion in the caves; Karn confronts Rona and buries him under rock.
events.quote: Rona was confronted by Karn, who managed to bury him under tons of rock.

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane finds and frees Karn.
events.quote: He was eventually found and freed by Ajani Goldmane .

relations.note: In the mountains of New Argive, part of the Terisian Isles.
relations.quote: part of the Terisian Isles on the plane of Dominaria

relations.note: Betrayed Phyrexia and teamed up with Urza.
relations.quote: Xantcha betrayed Phyrexia and teamed up with Urza against her former homeplane.

relations.note: Defeated Gix with Xantcha and Ratepe's sacrifice.
relations.quote: so that Urza could defeat Gix.
